payload.title: Anth.us-web default branch develop is 80 commits behind main; stale README on GitHub landing
payload.description:
**Problem**
The GitHub default branch develop is 80 commits behind main (develop has 18 commits main lacks), so visitors land on a stale README and stale instructions. AGENTS.md on main says develop's instructions are superseded.

**Evidence**
`git rev-list --count origin/develop..origin/main` = 80; `git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/develop` = 18 (2026-10-20).

**Fix**
Reconcile branches (without promoting unrelated develop changes to production, per AGENTS.md) or change the default branch to main. Update the README.

**How to verify**
`gh api repos/AnthusAI/Anth.us-web --jq .default_branch` returns the intended branch and its README matches current serving.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
